title: Trolley variations
summary: The classic dilemma, changed one variable at a time.
intro: A runaway train is heading toward people on the track. Each question changes one thing. There are no right answers.

questions.prompt: Pull the lever to send the train toward one stranger instead of five?
There's no lever. You could push a large man off a bridge to stop the train and save the five.
The one person on the side track is your close friend.

options.label: Pull the lever — my friend dies, five live

questions.prompt: Now the one person is your spouse.

options.label: Pull the lever — my spouse dies, five live

questions.prompt: Five adults on the main track. One child — a stranger — on the side track.

options.label: Pull the lever — the child dies
Leave it — the five adults die

questions.prompt: The one person on the side track is the one who tied the five to the rails.

options.label: Leave it — he's still a person

questions.prompt: You can't be sure pulling the lever will work. How uncertain could it be and you'd still pull?
questions.scenario: If it fails, the one on the side track dies and the five die too. Choose the lowest chance of success you'd still act on.
questions.noneLabel: I wouldn't pull at any odds

questions.prompt: You're a surgeon. Five patients will die without transplants. A healthy visitor is a match for all five.
